posts.title: Text Forge 0.2 - Stable Release
posts.excerpt: Text Forge v0.2.0 is now stable! After several betas and release candidates, this milestone delivers a polished foundation for the editor. Highlights include the powerful template system, synchronized preview scrolling, smart indentation per language, a bookmarks panel for quick navigation, UI filters for a cleaner workspace, and improved backup reliability with a critical security fix for plugin extraction. This release sets the stage for a robust ecosystem of modes, extensions, and community contributions.

posts.title: 0.2 - RC2 Stability & Final Preparations
posts.excerpt: The release of Text Forge v0.2.0-rc2 marks another step toward the upcoming stable milestone, with over 80 commits since rc1. This candidate brings key improvements such as mode-driven indentation settings, a new bookmarks panel, auto text direction, and enhanced backup reliability. It also includes important bug fixes and a security update for plugin extraction, making rc2 both a stability and polish release.

posts.title: Bookmarks & Smart Indentation Released
posts.excerpt: Say hi to Text Forge v0.2 - RC2: Bookmarks for quick navigation, smart indentation that adapts to your language, and UI filters for a cleaner workspace are now available. This update makes working with Text Forge smoother and more efficient.

posts.title: Template System & Synchronized Preview Scrolling
posts.excerpt: First Candidate Release 0.2 is out! It delivers a new and powerful template system, reusable document structures with customizable placeholders. Synced preview scrolling has also been added, so your preview page moves in sync with your editing.

posts.title: Theme-Aware Syntax Highlighting
posts.excerpt: Syntax highlighting colors now automatically adapt to your chosen theme. Plus, custom preview formats let you see your documents exactly how you want them.

posts.title: Introducing the Marketplace
posts.excerpt: The first beta of v0.2 brings theme support, the community Marketplace for sharing extensions, and the Text Forge Project Module (TFPM) for better project management.

posts.title: Explore the Mode Library
posts.excerpt: Discover community-created modes for different languages and file formats. From Markdown to configuration files, find the perfect mode for your workflow.

posts.title: Getting Started with Text Forge
posts.excerpt: New to Text Forge? Check out our comprehensive documentation to learn about modules, modes, action scripts, and how to customize your editing experience.
